https://docs.r4photobiology.info/ggpmisc/articles/major-axis-regression.html

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpmisc)

data$name <- factor(
  data$name,
  levels = c(
    "Clarisia  racemosa",
    "Pouteria torta",
    "Alchornea lojaensis",
    "Myrcia sp nov",
    "Hedyosmun  purpurascens",
    "Weinmania  loxensis"
  )
)
species_colors <- c(
  "Pouteria torta" = "orange",
  "Clarisia  racemosa" = "gold",
  "Alchornea lojaensis" = "green",
  "Myrcia sp nov" = "darkgreen",
  "Hedyosmun  purpurascens" = "purple",
  "Weinmania  loxensis" = "blue"
)

old_theme <- theme_set(theme_bw())



data$Treatment<- with(
  data,
  ifelse(N == 0 & P == 0, "C",
  ifelse(N == 1 & P == 0, "N",
  ifelse(N == 0 & P == 1, "P", "N:P")))
)

data$Treatment<- factor(
  data$Treatment,
  levels = c("C", "N", "P", "N:P")
)

sub_colors <- c(
  "C"  = "white",
  "N"  = "red",
  "P"  = "blue",
  "N:P" = "gray60"
)
```


```{r}
ggplot(data, aes(N_area, `iWUE (μmol/mol)`)) +
  
  geom_point(aes(fill= Treatment),
             shape = 21,
             color="black",
             size = 1.5) +#aes(shape = SUB), size = 3
  stat_ma_line(method = "SMA",color="black",linewidth = 0.5) +
  stat_ma_eq(
    method = "SMA",
    mapping = use_label("eq", "R2"),
    size =1.8,
  ) +
 scale_fill_manual(
    values = sub_colors)+
  facet_wrap(~name,nrow = 1)  +
  labs(
    x = "Narea",
    y = "iWUE (μmol/mol)",
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        strip.text = element_text(
      size = 7,
      face = "italic")
  )

ggsave(
  "Narea_iWUE_SMA.png",
  width = 180,      # mm
  height = 70,      # mm
  units = "mm",
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
library(smatr)


sma <-sma(`iWUE (μmol/mol)`~ N_area, data = datos_Pouteria)
summary(sma)

sma2 <-sma(`iWUE (μmol/mol)`~ N_area, data = datos_Clarisia)
summary(sma2)

sma3 <-sma(`iWUE (μmol/mol)`~ N_area, data = datos_al)
summary(sma3)

sma4 <-sma(`iWUE (μmol/mol)`~ N_area, data = datos_myrcia)
summary(sma4)

sma5 <-sma(`iWUE (μmol/mol)`~ N_area, data = datos_hp)
summary(sma5)

sma6 <-sma(`iWUE (μmol/mol)`~ N_area, data = datos_Weinmania)
summary(sma6)

```


```{r SLA}

ggplot(data, aes(`Specific leaf area (cm²/g)`, `iWUE (μmol/mol)`)) +
  geom_point(aes(fill= Treatment),
             shape = 21,
             color="black",
             size = 1.5) +#ae
    stat_ma_line(method = "SMA",color="black",linewidth = 0.5) +
  stat_ma_eq(
    method = "SMA",
   mapping = use_label("eq", "R2"),
  size =1.8, label.x = 0.98,
  label.y = 0.98,
  ) +
 scale_fill_manual(
    values = sub_colors )+
  facet_wrap(~name,nrow = 1)  +
  labs(
    x = "SLA (cm²/g)",
    y = "iWUE (μmol/mol)",
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        strip.text = element_text(
      size = 7,
      face = "italic")
  )

ggsave(
  "SLA_iWUE_SMA.png",
  width = 180,      # mm
  height = 70,      # mm
  units = "mm",
  dpi = 300
)

```
